session.title: Session
session.missingBody: This session is not part of the current programme.
session.longer: Longer than usual, about {{minutes}} min over your {{budget}} min: extra sets this week.
session.notNext: This is not the next session: the rotation follows its order.
session.sameEveryWeek: Same session every week: the cardio day doesn’t follow the phases.
session.previewNote: A look at another week. Today’s session stays the one from week {{week}}.
session.edited_one: Edited by you: 1 change, for the whole cycle.
session.edited_other: Edited by you: {{count}} changes, for the whole cycle.
session.copyHint: To make it your own session
session.placed: Your session, in place of session {{letter}} of the programme. It progresses and follows the weeks.

week.label: Week {{week}}
week.title: Week {{week}}, {{phase}}
week.test: This week’s test: as many {{names}} as possible.

group.ruleCircuit: All {{count}} back to back, then rest {{rest}} s.

rx.maxHint: Max: as many clean reps as you can

readapt.summary: Easier sets: you ease back in and find your marks.
readapt.goal: Learn the movements and find the right loads, without soreness that holds you back.

volume.summary: More volume: one extra set on the first exercises of each session.
volume.goal: More work to build muscle, without going to failure.

intensity.summary: Heavier loads on the first set, slightly lighter sets after it.
intensity.goal: Load up: the first set is hard, the next ones stay clean.

peak.summary: The week of your heaviest loads, with only a rep or two in reserve.
peak.goal: Go after your best loads before letting yourself recover.

deload.summary: A lighter week: fewer sets to recover before the next cycle.
deload.goal: Recover to come back stronger, then measure your progress.

phase.effortHelp_one: End each set when you could still do one clean rep.
phase.effortHelp_other: End each set when you could still do {{count}} clean reps.
phase.effortHelpFailure: Go to the end of the set, as long as your form stays clean.

rir.first-set: {{effort}} on the first set, then slightly lighter sets

bullet.extraSets_one: +{{add}} set on the first exercise of each session
bullet.extraSets_other: +{{add}} set on the first {{count}} exercises of each session
bullet.cardio: +{{minutes}} min of cardio at the end of the session, if time allows
bullet.maxTest: Max test at the end of the week: {{names}}

phase.sameLoads: Same exercises; loads go up when you reach the top of the range.

whyCard.title: Why this programme?
whyCard.schedule_one: One session a week, fitted to your schedule.
whyCard.schedule_other: {{sessions}} sessions a week, fitted to your schedule.
whyCard.bodyweight: Just bodyweight, a chair, a table and a door.
whyCard.equipment: Chosen with the equipment you own.

banner.title: Programme out of date
banner.outOfDate: Your profile or equipment changed since this programme was made. A new programme can take that into account.
banner.needsNew: Your goal or number of days changed: the session split no longer fits.

nudge.title_one: {{count}} exercise adapted for lack of equipment
nudge.title_other: {{count}} exercises adapted for lack of equipment

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.intro: Always in order. A missed day shifts the rotation; nothing is skipped. Tap a phase to see what changes.

meta.withCardio_one: {{weeks}} weeks, {{count}} session (+ {{cardio}} cardio day) a week
meta.withCardio_other: {{weeks}} weeks, {{count}} sessions (+ {{cardio}} cardio day) a week

menu.variantHint: Changes secondary exercises. You see the changes before confirming.

preview.noneBody: With your current equipment, every exercise is already the best choice available. More equipment opens up other options.
preview.keptVariant: Same split, same durations. You stay on week {{week}}.
preview.keptNewSplit: With {{days}} days a week, the split changes. Every exercise can change.
preview.keptNew: Same split, same durations. Loads and doses follow your current profile.
preview.restart: The new programme starts at week 1. Your past sessions stay in your history.
preview.openSession: A session is open: it carries on with its own plan and won’t count towards the new programme.

edits.title: Your changes
edits.allKept: All of them carry over to the new programme.

why.equipment: Needs {{equipment}}, no longer in your equipment.
why.unusable: This exercise is no longer possible with your new profile or equipment.
why.slotGone: The exercise leaves the session: the new programme’s version applies.
why.sessionGone: Session {{letter}} no longer exists with {{days}} days a week.
why.sessionGoneNoLetter: This session no longer exists with {{days}} days a week.
why.placementUnusable: Your session has an exercise that is no longer possible. It stays in My sessions.

edits.splitChanged_one: The split changes: your change no longer applies.
edits.splitChanged_other: The split changes: your {{count}} changes no longer apply.

whySheet.first: First exercise of the session: the main movement, while you are freshest.
whySheet.plain: The classic choice for this movement, fitted to your equipment and level.

restore.title: Restore the programme’s session?
restore.body_one: Your change to session {{letter}} is erased, for every week. Sessions you’ve done stay in your history.
restore.body_other: Your {{count}} changes to session {{letter}} are erased, for every week. Sessions you’ve done stay in your history.

unplace.title: Remove from your programme?
unplace.body: {{name}} takes back session {{letter}}, with its loads. Your session stays in My sessions.

edit.range: Edited by you: {{new}} instead of {{old}}. Same load, goal re-set.
edit.added: Added by you. Starting load from your history.
edit.addedNew: Added by you. First time: estimated starting load.
edit.grouped: Put in a superset by you.
